annotations.title: List the firms of a market

description: The firms of one market, by grouping (Bank, Broker-dealer, Investment firm, Fund manager, Venue, Other) or by status in the register's own words, paged.

market.description: The market, two letters (for example uk). On a market's own MCP it may be left out.

status.description: A status exactly as the register writes it (the answer's statuses list names them).
